obligations.behavior: Elaborate and operate cleanly across parameterized (DataW, Height, Width, UseLatches) including degenerate Height==1, Width==1, and D==1 as well as deep multi-block D>=3 configurations.
Prevent 2*Height ping-pong buffer overrun when D>=3 and ensure seamless multi-tile transitions and flags_o.empty pulses across D==1, D>=2, preloaded tiles (flags_o.full==1), and random stalls.
Deterministically drive zero ('0) for columns >= ctrl_i.height and rows >= loaded_width even after ctrl_i.rst_w_index resets the row-load counter mid-drain.
Prioritize synchronous clear_i over simultaneous load/h_shift, preserve latch-free UseLatches=0 and latch-based UseLatches=1 synthesis, and prevent 4-state X/Z leakage onto flags_o or x_buffer_o.
